topline.text: A genuinely quiet 24-48 hours for UK education news - no major DfE, Ofsted, SEND/AP, behaviour, safeguarding or funding stories broke overnight, and nothing new has surfaced from Sheffield or South Yorkshire either.
Rather than pad this out with last week's stories, today's briefing is short - normal service (and length) resumes as soon as something genuinely new lands.

diary.text: ONS publishes its latest NEET (not in education, employment or training) statistics for the UK - relevant to post-16 pathways and AP/SEND transitions work.

box.label: Jargon-buster - AP
box.intro: Seen in SEND reform coverage this term:
box.text: 'Alternative Provision' (AP) - education arranged for pupils who can't attend mainstream school, including due to exclusion, illness or SEND. Current reform proposals would shift AP toward earlier, in-school support rather than off-site placement after things break down.
